metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Bank Portal" "C4 model of the online banking platform" {

    model {

        customer = person "Bank Customer" "A customer of the bank who uses the platform to manage their accounts, move money, and track their activity."

        cardNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "A card payment network operated by a different organization." external
        creditAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "A credit reference agency operated by a different organization." external

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform, owned and operated by our company." {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts."
            mobileBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app."
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records."
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers."
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers."
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards."
            fraudDetection = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud."
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts."
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers."
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements."
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits."
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates."
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation."
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts."
            ledgerDb = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement."
            customerDb = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records."
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail."
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data."
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs."
        }

        customer -> bankPortal "Manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"
        bankPortal -> cardNetwork "Routes card authorisations"
        bankPortal -> creditAgency "Performs credit checks"

        customer -> webPortal "Manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"
        customer -> mobileBackend "Manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"

        webPortal -> accountService "Uses"
        webPortal -> transactionService "Uses"
        webPortal -> paymentService "Uses"
        webPortal -> cardService "Uses"
        webPortal -> statementsService "Uses"
        webPortal -> directDebitService "Uses"

        mobileBackend -> accountService "Uses"
        mobileBackend -> transactionService "Uses"
        mobileBackend -> paymentService "Uses"
        mobileBackend -> cardService "Uses"
        mobileBackend -> statementsService "Uses"
        mobileBackend -> directDebitService "Uses"

        transactionService -> ledgerDb "Updates"
        transactionService -> fraudDetection "Scores transactions"
        transactionService -> eventQueue "Publishes events"

        notificationService -> eventQueue "Consumes events"
        statementsService -> ledgerDb "Reads"
        statementsService -> documentStore "Writes"
        batchScheduler -> ledgerDb "Reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> customerDb "Reads and writes"

        paymentService -> cardService "Uses"
        paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "Uses"
        onboardingService -> customerDb "Reads"

        paymentService -> cardNetwork "Routes card authorisations"
        onboardingService -> creditAgency "Performs credit checks"
    }

    views {

        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "Who uses the Bank Portal and which external systems it depends on" {
            include customer
            include cardNetwork
            include creditAgency
            autoLayout
        }

        container bankPortal "FrontOffice" "How customers manage accounts, move money, and track activity" {
            include customer
            include webPortal
            include mobileBackend
            include accountService
            include transactionService
            include paymentService
            include cardService
            include statementsService
            include directDebitService
            include exchangeRatesService
            include onboardingService
            include customerDb
            include cardNetwork
            include creditAgency
            autoLayout
        }

        container bankPortal "RiskCompliance" "How transactions are scored for fraud and new customers are verified" {
            include transactionService
            include fraudDetection
            include onboardingService
            include creditAgency
            include customerDb
            include auditDb
            autoLayout
        }

        container bankPortal "DataAndBatch" "How account movements are stored, batch-processed, and customers are notified" {
            include transactionService
            include notificationService
            include statementsService
            include batchScheduler
            include eventQueue
            include ledgerDb
            include customerDb
            include documentStore
            include cache
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}
